sloka: सहसंवृद्धभावाच्च संसर्गेण च मानद ।यद्यहं ते न विज्ञाता हता तेनास्मि शाश्वतम् ।। ६.११९.१० ।।
transliteration: sahasaṁvṛddhabhāvācca saṁsargeṇa ca mānada ।yadyahaṁ te na vijñātā hatā tenāsmi śāśvatam ।। 6.119.10 ।।

translations.english: "Honourable Rama! If I am not understood by you despite our growing up together with love and in spite of our intimate relationship, I am done forever."
